bibl.title: Tolemeo III dal ritorno in Egitto al decreto di Canopo: tempi e ragioni di due visite nella chora.
bibl.seg: 145.4 P. Hibeh I, 82 P. Lond. VII, 2056 P. Tebt. III, 748; 749
Lorenzo Fati, Tolemeo III dal ritorno in Egitto al decreto di Canopo: tempi e ragioni di due visite nella chora.

Mario Capasso, Paola Davoli & Natascia Pellé (edd.), Proceedings of the 29th International Congress of Papyrology. Lecce, 28 July - 3 August 2019 = Quaderni dell'Istituto superiore universitario di formazione interdisciplinare. 2 (Lecce, 2022) I, pp. 423-439.
bibl.note: P. Lond. VII, 2056 and P. Tebt. III, 748-749 - undated, but attributable to the period 243/242 B.C. - allude to a journey of Ptolemy III in the nomoi Arsinoites and Oxyrhynchites. It has been suggested that this visit to Upper Egypt was part of his maiden trip. Suggests another explanation, reconsidering, in addition to the above mentioned three texts, also P. Hib. I, 82, 14-22. On the contrary, an evidence of the Ptolemy III's maiden trip is probably to be found in I. Philae I, 4.
